Rashi on Chullin 21a:1:1.hebrew: מ"מ קשיא - וכי מתה עומד ומולק?
Rashi on Chullin 21a:1:1.english: In any case, it is difficult - Does one stand and pinch [the neck of a bird that is] dead?

Rashi on Chullin 21a:1:2.hebrew: בלא רוב - רוחב הבשר של מפרקת, דאכתי לאו מתה היא, דהא זעירי מפרקת ורוב בשר קאמר:
Rashi on Chullin 21a:1:2.english: Without the majority - The width of the flesh of the neck, for [the animal] is not yet dead, since Ze'iri said [the case of] the neck [bone broken] together with the majority of the flesh.

Rashi on Chullin 21a:2:2.hebrew: א"ל - הואיל ומתה, חשוב כל מליקות דאמר רחמנא דבעי לחתוך סימנים, וכי מתה עומד ומולק:
Rashi on Chullin 21a:2:2.english: He said to him - Since it died, [the act] is considered a complete *melikah*, [since] the Merciful One said that [melikah] requires cutting the signs [i.e., the windpipe and gullet]. But [how can one perform melikah on a bird] once it is dead? Does one stand and perform melikah [on a dead bird]?

Rashi on Chullin 21a:2:3.hebrew: אשתומם - שתק, והיה מחשב מה יענה:
Rashi on Chullin 21a:2:3.english: He was astonished - He fell silent and was considering what he would answer.
